tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The vibrant core: primary buttons, active states and the logo's orange. Always carries an ink label (on-brand), never white. As text it fails on light grounds: use brand-text.

tokens.name: brand-dim
tokens.usage: Hover state of brand fills and borders.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange-toned text and eyebrows on page, surface and brand-tint. Above 5:1 in every theme. Never set small text in brand itself.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange ground for brand badges and highlights.

tokens.name: brand-tint-border
tokens.usage: Border of brand badges.

tokens.name: brand-tint-text
tokens.usage: Text of brand badges on brand-tint.

tokens.name: brand-2
tokens.usage: Secondary teal accent for decorative marks and highlights. Not for text on white (about 2.5:1); use success for teal text.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is the app; Cream is the deck paper and marketing; Cocoa is the dark ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus and the secondary button fill.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset or raised surface and muted badge ground.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Resting background of text fields; becomes surface on focus.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Subtle dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: fields and quiet outlines. 3:1 against page and surface in every theme.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border on secondary buttons.

tokens.name: warm-border
tokens.usage: Warm hairline on profile and marketing panels sitting on page or surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on page, surface and surface-2 in every theme (above 11:1). Also the dark button fill.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headlines and page titles.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Ground for the footer and full-bleed dark marketing bands, with white or cream text on top (about 18:1). Never use as text on page or surface. Hover of the dark button is black.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and ghost labels on page and surface; 5:1 or better in every theme.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Descriptions and helper lines on page and surface; 4.5:1 or better on page and surface in every theme (Light is 5.1:1 on page, 5.3:1 on surface; the source app uses #777777, which misses).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, icons and large text. About 3.5:1 on white in Light, so not for body copy there (source value kept exact).

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder only.

tokens.name: warm-text
tokens.usage: Warm gray body text on warm-border panels (about 6:1 on white).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill and teal text on surface. Light: white label on the fill passes (about 5:1). Cream: darkened to 4.9:1 on page, white label 5.8:1. Cocoa: lightened to 5.0:1 on surface and 6.2:1 on page; as a fill there, use an on-brand (ink) label, not white.

tokens.name: success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of success fills.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border of success badges.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text of success badges on success-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of warning badges.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text of warning badges on warning-tint (about 5.7:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fill with an on-danger (white) label, 5.4:1. Darkened from the source's #D94848 so the label passes.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of danger fills.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of danger badges.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of danger badges.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text of danger badges on danger-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border of info badges.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text of info badges on info-tint.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The signature line: 1.5px borders on buttons and featured cards, and the hard offset shadow colour. Ink on light grounds, cream on cocoa.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label colour on brand, terracotta and sage fills. Ink on brand is 6.6:1; white on brand is 2.9:1, so never white.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label colour on danger fills (5.4:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Deck paper and marketing ground; also the text colour on cocoa. Same value in every theme.

tokens.name: cocoa
tokens.usage: Dark deck and marketing ground. Cream text on it is above 11:1.

tokens.name: cocoa-2
tokens.usage: Raised panel on cocoa, rings and quiet shapes.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Muted orange for chart fills, blocks and the second voice beside brand. Ink label passes (6.1:1).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Orange on cocoa: big numbers and highlights on dark (6.5:1 on cocoa).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Deep orange for emphasis text on cream (4.9:1) and surface such as a punchline, and the key slice of a chart.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Muted green for chart fills, success blocks and the cool counterweight to orange. Ink label passes (6.7:1).

tokens.name: sage-light
tokens.usage: Green text on cocoa (9:1) and light green blocks.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm gray for quiet chart slices and dividers on cream.

tokens.name: sand-light
tokens.usage: Lightest warm gray, the first slice of a chart and hairlines on cream.

styles.name: display-mega
styles.usage: Posters, covers and one-word statements. Barlow Condensed 800, uppercase, line-height .84, flush left. Scales fluidly in code (clamp to 60px on phones).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Landing and profile heroes. Uppercase, near-white on cocoa or ink on cream.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO SELL FROM THE TRUCK
styles.usage: H2 headlines and public-page names, uppercase, line-height .9.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and section headings, uppercase.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Large panel and band headings, uppercase. Cards use heading (sentence case) instead.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Large button label. Uppercase, line-height 1, centred by flex, never by padding.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and empty-state titles in ink-strong, sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Create an account and start building out your artist profile.
styles.usage: Default UI copy in ink or text-subtle.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above headlines, in brand-text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Specimen captions, state names and fine print in muted or text-subtle.

spacing.note: Tailwind 4px scale. Controls are 40px tall (space-10); cards pad 24px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gaps inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked fields and button groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, field padding, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page header bottom margin and section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Minimum control height (min-h-10).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding and large section gaps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small chips and menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Fields and list items.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels and media tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, pills, avatars: every button is a full pill.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: The punk shadow: a hard, un-blurred offset in edge colour. Button hover and featured cards.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Small hard shadow for focused fields and badges.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting quiet card elevation, barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Feature panels and workspace cards.
